title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Run His Own Life
caption:
Freedom isn't the absence of rules. It's not being ruled by your own urges either.

The world sold you a version of freedom that looks like doing whatever you want, whenever you feel it. Scripture sells something sturdier: a man under God's authority who can finally be trusted with his own.

The urge still knocks. It just doesn't get a key anymore.

#faith #discipline #godlyman #selfcontrol #christianmen #galatians
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
